title: France 2026 — Nice to Narbonne
subtitle: Ten nights, six bases, east-to-west across the south
summary: Modernism arc through Provence, ending at the train to Bordeaux. The current trip in active planning.

lodgingOptions: La Colombe d'Or (legendary, expensive, must book now)

Smaller hotels or rentals in historic center

days.title: Arrival
days.summary: Land Nice via Paris connect, settle into Saint-Paul area, easy first night.

stops.notes: Pick up rental car at NCE airport, ~30 min drive to Saint-Paul.

days.title: Maeght and Colombe d'Or
days.summary: The Riviera's modernist heart. Sert's 1964 building, then the legendary inn for lunch.

stops.notes: Coffee, flowers, socca. Hitchcock flower-market location.
Sert 1964. Miró labyrinth, Calder, Giacometti, Braque chapel. 2-3 hours.
Long lunch on fig-shaded terrace. Reserve 3-4 weeks ahead. [BOOK NOW]
OPTIONAL — skip if energy is low. Light through the windows.

days.title: Cap Moderne, then the still center
days.summary: Morning at E-1027 and Le Corbusier's Cabanon. Drive west to La Celle for the ritual night.

stops.notes: E-1027 + Cabanon. 2-hour French tour. [BOOK NOW via capmoderne@monuments-nationaux.fr]
Beach restaurant directly below site. Where Le Corbusier ate with the Rebutatos.
Lucrèce de Barras suite [LOCKED]. The trip's still center. Dinner at the Hostellerie.

days.title: Le Thoronet, then Cassis
days.summary: Morning at the 12th-century Cistercian abbey, the architectural ancestor. Drive to Cassis for the next two nights.

stops.notes: Cistercian masterpiece. Le Corbusier studied this for La Tourette. Aim for morning light through the apse.
Settle in. Calanque de Port-Miou walk if energy permits (20 min from village).

days.title: Marseille day from Cassis
days.summary: Cité Radieuse, Tuba Club lunch with a swim, optional Maison Empereur in the afternoon.

stops.notes: Roof terrace free and open. Post-war 'vertical village' completes the Le Corbusier arc.
Long lunch with swim. Bring swimsuits. 3-4 hours. [BOOK NOW]
OPTIONAL — Path A. The 8-generation hardware store. Buy something.

days.title: Cassis → Aix → Lourmarin
days.summary: Transition day from coast to inland. Vasarely's hexagonal temple, lunch in Aix, then to the Luberon base.

stops.notes: Contemporary cuisine in Aix. Reserve 2 weeks ahead.
Vasarely's 16-hexagon temple, 1971-76. 2 hours.
Arrive Luberon base. Light dinner — save the big meals for tomorrow.

days.title: The Luberon slow day
days.summary: Vaugines and Mirabeau (Jean de Florette / Manon des Sources locations) in the morning, La Petite Maison de Cucuron for lunch, café on the Place de l'Étang.

stops.notes: Berri's filming location. Mariage de Manon, scène finale. 5 min from Lourmarin.
The fountain (the dry one Manon caused), Café de la Fontaine, school-now-mairie.
Eric Sapet, 1 Michelin star. Reserve 2-3 weeks ahead.
Long café on the platanes-shaded square next door. Slow Provence afternoon.

days.title: Luberon → Vaucluse → Uzès
days.summary: Brun de Vian-Tiran wool manufactory at l'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue, then west across the Rhône into Languedoc.

stops.notes: Last integrated French wool mill. 1.5h tour with Edgar le mouton for Nève.
Light lunch at canal-side terrace. Walk the canals, antique shops.
Arrive Uzès. Walk Place aux Herbes, Duché, Tour Fenestrelle. Dinner at La Table d'Uzès or Le Tracteur.

days.title: Pont du Gard, then Sète
days.summary: Roman aqueduct in the morning (swim in the Gardon), drive west to Sète for the last two nights.

stops.notes: Walk across, swim in the Gardon. Picnic by the river.
Arrive Sète. Cimetière marin, Les Halles centrales, the canals.

days.title: Sète and Bouzigues — the slow last day
days.summary: Oysters in Bouzigues across the lagoon, Mont Saint-Clair walk, last simple dinner on the canals.

stops.notes: Oyster shacks across the Étang de Thau. Producers serve their own oysters. Great simple meal in France.
Paul Valéry's burial place. Read the poem first.

days.title: Train day
days.summary: Drive Sète → Narbonne, drop the rental car, take the TGV to Bordeaux.

stops.notes: Drop rental car. TGV to Bordeaux ~3 hours.

openDecisions.question: Has Nève watched the Berri films / Hitchcock?
